topic_title: Adjusting Speed for Poor Weather & Flash Floods
prompt: What are the legal criminal penalties under Texas Transportation Code §472.022 for driving around a flood barricade?

options.text: A standard parking citation with a ten-dollar municipal court administrative fee
Mandatory forfeiture of all personal motor vehicles to the Texas Department of Public Safety
Class B misdemeanor punishable by fines up to $1,000 and up to 180 days in jail
Immediate permanent revocation of driving privileges with no right of administrative appeal
